title: The Missing Lecture Key
description: Use the clues to identify the student who has the missing lecture key.
problemStatement: Four students attended four different labs. The key belongs to the student who attended neither the coding lab nor the robotics lab. Which student is it?
hint: Eliminate the students connected to the coding and robotics labs.

title: Array Signal Decoder
description: Identify the output produced by a short array transformation.
problemStatement: A Python list contains [2, 4, 6, 8]. If every element is multiplied by 2, what is the resulting list?
hint: Multiply each original element by two.

title: Campus Memory Sprint
description: Train short-term recall with a sequence of campus symbols.
problemStatement: Remember the sequence shown in the clue: BOOK → STAR → TREE → CLOCK. Which symbol appears third?
hint: Count from the beginning of the sequence.

title: The Student Event Budget
description: Make the best decision from a constrained student event budget.
problemStatement: A club has ₹1,000. It spends ₹350 on printing and ₹250 on refreshments. How much remains?
hint: Subtract both expenses from the starting budget.
